name: @pipeworx/mcp-seo-competitors

tools.name: seo_domain_ranked_keywords
tools.description: What keywords does `<domain>` rank for — returns the keywords a domain ranks for in Google organic, with search volume, current rank, and ranking URL. Competitor SEO intelligence. Example: seo_domain_ranked_keywords({ target: "nike.com", location_code: 2840, limit: 50, _apiKey: "your-base64-key" })

_apiKey.description: DataForSEO API key = base64("login:password") from your dataforseo.com account

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-seo-competitors forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the seo-competitors pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
